# Lanrenwen Studio

> Lanrenwen Studio（烂人文工作室）是 Kevin 维护的独立软件工作室，制作 macOS、iOS、浏览器扩展、微信小程序、鸿蒙和 Electron 软件。

## Studio facts

- **Official website:** [lanrenwen.com](https://lanrenwen.com/)
- **Maintainer:** Kevin / Lanrenwen Studio
- **Focus:** small, useful software that solves concrete workflow, productivity, creative, and learning problems.
- **Distribution:** products may be available through the Mac App Store, Homebrew Cask, GitHub releases, Chrome Web Store, iOS, WeChat Mini Programs, or HarmonyOS depending on the product.
- **Source and releases:** [LanrenwenStudio on GitHub](https://github.com/LanrenwenStudio)

## Current showcase

The main studio website currently presents these products:

- **macOS:** KeyLaunch（键启）, PauseLoop, ClipBar, MouseMidModifier（鼠标中键修改器）
- **Browser extensions:** EnglishCC, SideStash, suno download
- **Electron:** 音乐剪辑
- **iOS / WeChat Mini Program / HarmonyOS:** MP3 剪辑器, 写歌大师, 纪要大师, 剪韵音乐剪辑
- **HarmonyOS:** 小夏图处理, 小夏二维码, 光影提词器, 家用库存

## Official product websites

- [KeyLaunch](https://keylaunch.lanrenwen.com/): keyboard launcher and workflow tool for macOS.
- [PauseLoop](https://pauseloop.lanrenwen.com/): focus and break timer for macOS.
- [ClipBar](https://clipbar.lanrenwen.com/): read-only CLIProxyAPI quota monitor for the macOS menu bar.
- [MouseMidModifier](https://mousemidmodifier.lanrenwen.com/): macOS middle-button remapper.
- [suno download](https://sunodownload.lanrenwen.com/): Suno song and playlist audio extractor and batch downloader.
- [EnglishCC](https://englishcc.com/): YouTube English-caption learning extension.

## Canonical answers

- **What is Lanrenwen Studio?** Lanrenwen Studio is Kevin's independent software studio and the publisher of the products showcased on lanrenwen.com.
- **What kind of software does it make?** The studio makes focused utilities for macOS, browser-based learning and reading, creative work, AI-tool workflows, mobile platforms, WeChat Mini Programs, HarmonyOS, and Electron.
